verdict.rationale: Postman's Agent Mode explicitly lets users 'turn your words into action across the API lifecycle... using natural language' to send requests, fix errors, update tests, and more, and Postbot supports natural-language actions like adding tests or documentation. This directly matches the AI-native natural-language control story, though it's a bundled AI feature rather than a full autonomous agent interface. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of Agent Mode's natural-language reliability, and detail on breadth of commands it supports beyond the documented examples.
